releases.notes:
## News

- Added mc tweak `playerListScale` (#149)
- Added feature `freecamTeleportCommand` (#153)
- Added 5 `autoCollectMaterialListItem` sub-options
  - Added `autoCollectMaterialListItemExtraAmount` (#131)
  - Added `autoCollectMaterialListItemRequireSufficientSupply` (#137, #143)
  - Added `autoCollectMaterialListItemRoundUpToStack`
  - Added `autoCollectMaterialListItemTakeShulkerBoxes` and `autoCollectMaterialListItemShulkerBoxFillThreshold` (#132)
- Added mc tweak `blockBreakingCooldownOverride` and `blockBreakingCooldownOverrideValue` (#119)
- Added mc tweak `signEditScreenClearAllButton` (#116)
- Added feature `vehicleFakeSneaking` (#92)

## Changes

- Added a hotkey search button next to the search bar in the config GUI

## Fixes

- Fixed `autoSchematicPickBlock` not compatible with `accurateBlockPlacement` (#118)

releases.notes:
## News

- Added feature tweak `shulkerBoxItemContentHintShowBarOnMixed` (#64)
- Added mc tweak `disableF3BEntityFacingVector` and `f3BEntityFacingVectorLength`

## Changes

- Improved user experience for `shulkerBoxItemContentHint` for nbt-difference-only boxes (#38)
- `serverDataSyncer` now supports litematica area clone (#63)
- `copySignTextToClipBoard` now supports targeting sign block in litematica schematic world

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2bb9cf81-a30d-43e2-8a5c-d1a636fa2019)

## Fixes

- Fixed incompatibility with extra player enderer v3 (#68)
- Fixed `windowSizePinned` does not modify the initial window size
- (mc1.21) Fix crashing due to tweakeroo changes in sakura-ryoko's fork (#69)

## Patches

### v3.20.1

- Fixed `flawlessFrames` does not work after the first enabling (#70)

### v3.20.2

- (mc1.16.5) Fixed `copySignTextToClipBoard` crash the game with latest 1.16.4/5 litematica (#71)
  - For mc1.16.5 users, please update your litematica to `litematica-fabric-1.16.5-0.0.0-dev.20210917.192300.jar`
